neighbours.label: A relational adjective that names the domain of its noun (financial support, numerical estimate, geographic location, chemical composition); the same noun alone or with a plain adjective stays quiet
fire: She studies the chemical composition of the glass.
The firm faces serious financial trouble this year.
Its geographic location made it a trading port.
The visual appearance of the site was poor.
They lacked the logistical capacity to feed the troops.
This is a numerical estimate of the total.
The monetary value of the gift was small.
He has no financial interest in the company.
quiet: She studies the old windows of the church.
The firm faces serious trouble this year.
Its pretty location made it a popular port.
The appearance of the site was poor.
They lacked the capacity to feed the troops.
This is a rough estimate of the total.
The value of the gift was small.
He has no interest in the company.

notes: Card: ' financial' x9, ' numerical' x4, ' geographic' x3, ' geographical' x2, ' chemical' x2, ' visual' x2, ' logistical', ' monetary'. Logit effect promotes ' representation', ' makeup', ' framework'. Probe: numerical 0.80, monetary 0.62, geographical 0.55, financial 0.45, logistical 0.45; 'strong support' 0.01, 'many resources' 0.01. The - pole has the same family ('ological', ' Economic').
